description: This file contains JavaScript code for handling form input interactions, including validation, dynamic label activation, textarea auto-resizing, and form reset handling, specifically tailored for Materialize CSS framework.

methods.name: updateTextFields
methods.description: Updates label and icon classes based on input value and placeholder presence.

methods.name: validateField
methods.description: Validates input fields with 'validate' class, toggling 'valid' and 'invalid' classes based on validity.

methods.name: textAreaAutoResize
methods.description: Automatically resizes textarea elements based on their content.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes auto-resize for textareas and sets up event listeners for form interactions.
